reference.code: use std::collections::HashSet;pub fn header_normalization(s:&str)->Option<String>{if s.is_empty(){return None}let mut seen=HashSet::new();let mut o=vec![];for x in s.split(','){let p:Vec<_>=x.split('-').collect();if x.is_empty()||!x.as_bytes()[0].is_ascii_alphabetic()||!p.iter().all(|z|!z.is_empty()&&z.bytes().all(|c|c.is_ascii_alphanumeric())){return None}let n=x.to_ascii_lowercase();if !seen.insert(n.clone()){return None}o.push(n)}o.sort();Some(o.join(","))}
